en: She came from a minor German principality to the powerful Russian Empire and seized control
zh: 她來自一個小型德國公國，來到強大的俄羅斯帝國並掌握了控制權
ja: 彼女は小さなドイツの公国から強大なロシア帝国にやって来て、支配権を握りました
local: She came from a minor German principality to the powerful Russian Empire and seized control
native: She came from a minor German principality to the powerful Russian Empire and seized control

en: there.
zh: 那裡。
ja: そこです。
local: there.
native: there.

en: She became the Russian Serena, waged wars, loved passionately, and made Russia great.
zh: 她成為了俄羅斯的塞蕾娜，發動戰爭，熱情地愛著，並使俄羅斯偉大起來。
ja: 彼女はロシアのセリーナとなり、戦争を起こし、情熱的に愛し、ロシアを偉大にしました。
local: She became the Russian Serena, waged wars, loved passionately, and made Russia great.
native: She became the Russian Serena, waged wars, loved passionately, and made Russia great.

en: In 1744, the future Catherine the Great traveled to Russia.
zh: 1744年，未來的凱薩琳大帝前往俄羅斯。
ja: 1744年、未来のエカチェリーナ大帝はロシアへ旅立ちました。
local: In 1744, the future Catherine the Great traveled to Russia.
native: In 1744, the future Catherine the Great traveled to Russia.

en: At that time, she was still the young German princess, Sophie Friedricha Augusta, of
zh: 當時，她仍是年輕的德國公主，索菲·弗里德里卡·奧古斯塔，來自
ja: その時、彼女はまだ若いドイツの王女、ゾフィー・フリードリカ・アウグスタでした。
local: At that time, she was still the young German princess, Sophie Friedricha Augusta, of
native: At that time, she was still the young German princess, Sophie Friedricha Augusta, of

en: Anhalt Zerpst.
zh: 安哈特-策普斯特。
ja: アンハルト・ツェルプスト。
local: Anhalt Zerpst.
native: Anhalt Zerpst.

en: The Empress had requested Sophie's mother to bring her daughter to St. Petersburg.
zh: 女皇曾要求索菲的母親將她的女兒帶到聖彼得堡。
ja: 女帝はゾフィーの母親に娘をサンクトペテルブルクに連れてくるよう依頼しました。
local: The Empress had requested Sophie's mother to bring her daughter to St. Petersburg.
native: The Empress had requested Sophie's mother to bring her daughter to St. Petersburg.

en: Elizabeth was seeking a bride for her nephew in order to secure the succession.
zh: 伊麗莎白為了確保繼承權，正在為她的侄子尋找新娘。
ja: エリザベスは甥のために後継者を確保するために花嫁を探していました。
local: Elizabeth was seeking a bride for her nephew in order to secure the succession.
native: Elizabeth was seeking a bride for her nephew in order to secure the succession.

en: Peter was the grand Duke of Holstein, another small German state.
zh: 彼得是霍爾斯坦的大公，另一個小型德國國家。
ja: ペーターはホルシュタインの大公で、別の小さなドイツの国でした。
local: Peter was the grand Duke of Holstein, another small German state.
native: Peter was the grand Duke of Holstein, another small German state.

en: The orphaned early raised strictly, sickly.
zh: 這位孤兒從小被嚴格養育，體弱多病。
ja: 孤児であり、幼い頃から厳しく育てられ、病弱でした。
local: The orphaned early raised strictly, sickly.
native: The orphaned early raised strictly, sickly.

en: He was supposed to be tame, but mentally and emotionally he was underdeveloped.
zh: 他本應馴服，但在心理和情感上發育不全。
ja: 彼は従順であるはずでしたが、精神的にも感情的にも未熟でした。
local: He was supposed to be tame, but mentally and emotionally he was underdeveloped.
native: He was supposed to be tame, but mentally and emotionally he was underdeveloped.

en: He neglected his preparation for the Regency.
zh: 他忽視了對攝政的準備。
ja: 彼は摂政の準備を怠っていました。
local: He neglected his preparation for the Regency.
native: He neglected his preparation for the Regency.

en: Catherine reported later.
zh: 凱薩琳後來報告說。
ja: 後にエカチェリーナは報告しました。
local: Catherine reported later.
native: Catherine reported later.

en: In his first days, he tried very hard to impress me.
zh: 在他剛開始的日子裡，他非常努力地想給我留下深刻印象。
ja: 彼は最初の日々に私に良い印象を与えようと一生懸命でした。
local: In his first days, he tried very hard to impress me.
native: In his first days, he tried very hard to impress me.

en: I noticed and understood that he cared very little about the nation he would one day rule
zh: 我注意到並理解他對將來要統治的國家幾乎不關心
ja: 私は彼がいつか支配する国にほとんど関心がないことに気づき、理解しました。
local: I noticed and understood that he cared very little about the nation he would one day rule
native: I noticed and understood that he cared very little about the nation he would one day rule

en: and that he was still quite childish.
zh: 而且他仍然相當幼稚。
ja: そして彼はまだかなり子供っぽかったのです。
local: and that he was still quite childish.
native: and that he was still quite childish.

en: My soldiers Peter admired Frederick the Great and reenact in battles with toy soldiers.
zh: 我的士兵彼得崇拜腓特烈大帝，並用玩具士兵重演戰鬥。
ja: 私の兵士であるペーターはフリードリヒ大王を崇拝し、玩具の兵隊で戦闘を再現していました。
local: My soldiers Peter admired Frederick the Great and reenact in battles with toy soldiers.
native: My soldiers Peter admired Frederick the Great and reenact in battles with toy soldiers.

en: For his studies or civics, he had very little sense.
zh: 對於他的學習或公民教育，他幾乎沒有感覺。
ja: 彼は学問や市民教育にほとんど関心がありませんでした。
local: For his studies or civics, he had very little sense.
native: For his studies or civics, he had very little sense.

en: He despised the Russians and even Sophie the German, he barely valued.
zh: 他鄙視俄羅斯人，甚至對德國人索菲也幾乎不重視。
ja: 彼はロシア人を軽蔑し、ドイツ人のゾフィーさえほとんど評価しませんでした。
local: He despised the Russians and even Sophie the German, he barely valued.
native: He despised the Russians and even Sophie the German, he barely valued.

en: Respectfully, I remained silent and listened, she writes, that's how she gained his trust.
zh: 她寫道：我尊重地保持沉默並傾聽，這就是她贏得他信任的方式。
ja: 彼女は書いています。「敬意を持って私は黙って聞き続けました。そうして彼の信頼を得たのです。」
local: Respectfully, I remained silent and listened, she writes, that's how she gained his trust.
native: Respectfully, I remained silent and listened, she writes, that's how she gained his trust.

en: He confessed that he loved a lady in waiting but would obey his aunt.
zh: 他坦白說他愛上一位侍女，但會服從他的姑媽。
ja: 彼は侍女を愛していると告白しましたが、叔母に従うと言いました。
local: He confessed that he loved a lady in waiting but would obey his aunt.
native: He confessed that he loved a lady in waiting but would obey his aunt.

en: Sophie still wanted to marry Peter, but above all to convince the Zars.
zh: 索菲仍然想嫁給彼得，但最重要的是說服沙皇們。
ja: ゾフィーはまだペーターと結婚したいと思っていましたが、何よりも皇帝たちを説得することが目的でした。
local: Sophie still wanted to marry Peter, but above all to convince the Zars.
native: Sophie still wanted to marry Peter, but above all to convince the Zars.

en: She managed to win over the Church by converting from Protestantism to Orthodoxy.
zh: 她成功地通過從新教改信東正教贏得了教會的支持。
ja: 彼女はプロテスタントから正教会に改宗することで教会の支持を得ることに成功しました。
local: She managed to win over the Church by converting from Protestantism to Orthodoxy.
native: She managed to win over the Church by converting from Protestantism to Orthodoxy.

en: I spent four months in the country and recited the creed in Russian before the entire court.
zh: 我在這個國家待了四個月，並在整個宮廷面前用俄語背誦了信條。
ja: 私はこの国で4ヶ月過ごし、宮廷全体の前でロシア語で信条を唱えました。
local: I spent four months in the country and recited the creed in Russian before the entire court.
native: I spent four months in the country and recited the creed in Russian before the entire court.

en: She was given the Russian name Catherine Alexeyevna.
zh: 她被賦予了俄羅斯名字凱薩琳·阿列克謝耶芙娜。
ja: 彼女はロシア名のエカチェリーナ・アレクセーエヴナを与えられました。
local: She was given the Russian name Catherine Alexeyevna.
native: She was given the Russian name Catherine Alexeyevna.

en: The wedding ceremony was held on August 21, 1745, a triumph of staging, diamonds, uniforms,
zh: 婚禮於1745年8月21日舉行，是一場舞台、鑽石、制服的盛大慶典，
ja: 結婚式は1745年8月21日に行われ、舞台演出、ダイヤモンド、制服の華やかな勝利でした。
local: The wedding ceremony was held on August 21, 1745, a triumph of staging, diamonds, uniforms,
native: The wedding ceremony was held on August 21, 1745, a triumph of staging, diamonds, uniforms,

en: endless ceremony, the bride played her part, perfect and the following night instead of closeness,
zh: 無盡的儀式，新娘完美地扮演了她的角色，但接下來的夜晚卻沒有親密，
ja: 終わりのない儀式で、新婦は完璧に役割を果たしましたが、翌晩は親密さの代わりに、
local: endless ceremony, the bride played her part, perfect and the following night instead of closeness,
native: endless ceremony, the bride played her part, perfect and the following night instead of closeness,

en: emptiness, Peter drank, Katarina waited, and that was it.
zh: 空虛，彼得喝酒，凱薩琳等待，就這樣結束了。
ja: 虚しさがあり、ペーターは酒を飲み、カタリナは待ちました。それで終わりでした。
local: emptiness, Peter drank, Katarina waited, and that was it.
native: emptiness, Peter drank, Katarina waited, and that was it.

en: The marriage remained unconscimated.
zh: 這段婚姻一直未被圓滿完成。
ja: 結婚は未消化のままでした。
local: The marriage remained unconscimated.
native: The marriage remained unconscimated.

en: By years without affection, Peter's world became bizarre.
zh: 多年缺乏感情，彼得的世界變得怪異。
ja: 愛情のない年月を経て、ペーターの世界は奇妙になりました。
local: By years without affection, Peter's world became bizarre.
native: By years without affection, Peter's world became bizarre.

en: He held court marshals for rats that had attacked his toy soldiers.
zh: 他將宮廷元帥當作攻擊他玩具士兵的老鼠。
ja: 彼は宮廷の元帥たちを、自分の玩具の兵隊を襲ったネズミだと思っていました。
local: He held court marshals for rats that had attacked his toy soldiers.
native: He held court marshals for rats that had attacked his toy soldiers.

en: Katarina was supposed to stand guard outside his door.
zh: 凱薩琳應該在他的門外守衛。
ja: カタリナは彼の部屋の外で見張りをすることになっていました。
local: Katarina was supposed to stand guard outside his door.
native: Katarina was supposed to stand guard outside his door.

en: Only my great desire for the crown kept me going, she said later.
zh: 她後來說，只有對王冠的強烈渴望支撐著我。
ja: 彼女は後に言いました。「王冠への強い欲望だけが私を支えていました。」
local: Only my great desire for the crown kept me going, she said later.
native: Only my great desire for the crown kept me going, she said later.

en: Not love, ambition kept her in the palace.
zh: 不是愛，而是野心讓她留在宮殿裡。
ja: 愛ではなく、野心が彼女を宮殿に留まらせました。
local: Not love, ambition kept her in the palace.
native: Not love, ambition kept her in the palace.

en: Katarina withdrew into herself and educated herself.
zh: 凱薩琳內心封閉並自我教育。
ja: カタリナは内に閉じこもり、自分自身を教育しました。
local: Katarina withdrew into herself and educated herself.
native: Katarina withdrew into herself and educated herself.

en: Tin soldiers, Prussian uniforms, mockery of Russians.
zh: 錫兵、普魯士制服、嘲笑俄羅斯人。
ja: ブリキの兵隊、プロイセンの制服、ロシア人への嘲笑。
local: Tin soldiers, Prussian uniforms, mockery of Russians.
native: Tin soldiers, Prussian uniforms, mockery of Russians.

en: In 1750, he started with another affair, an alienation became increasingly profound.
zh: 1750年，他開始了另一段外遇，疏離感日益加深。
ja: 1750年、彼は別の浮気を始め、疎外感がますます深まりました。
local: In 1750, he started with another affair, an alienation became increasingly profound.
native: In 1750, he started with another affair, an alienation became increasingly profound.

en: Reading Voltaire, constitutional theory, Roman history, getting through his complete works
zh: 閱讀伏爾泰、憲法理論、羅馬歷史，通讀他的全集
ja: ヴォルテール、憲法理論、ローマ史を読み、彼の全集を通読することは
local: Reading Voltaire, constitutional theory, Roman history, getting through his complete works
native: Reading Voltaire, constitutional theory, Roman history, getting through his complete works

en: takes stamina.
zh: 需要耐力。
ja: 体力が必要です。
local: takes stamina.
native: takes stamina.

en: She had it.
zh: 她有這個能力。
ja: 彼女にはそれがありました。
local: She had it.
native: She had it.

en: Education became her weapon, and yet she was isolated without a mother, without friends,
zh: 教育成為她的武器，但她孤立無援，沒有母親，沒有朋友，
ja: 教育は彼女の武器となりましたが、母も友人もいない孤立した状態でした。
local: Education became her weapon, and yet she was isolated without a mother, without friends,
native: Education became her weapon, and yet she was isolated without a mother, without friends,

en: without a husband, but with books.
zh: 沒有丈夫，但有書籍。
ja: 夫はいませんでしたが、本がありました。
local: without a husband, but with books.
native: without a husband, but with books.

en: She was taught in a courtyard where almost no one was educated.
zh: 她在一個幾乎沒有人受過教育的院子裡接受教育。
ja: 彼女はほとんど誰も教育を受けていない中庭で教育を受けました。
local: She was taught in a courtyard where almost no one was educated.
native: She was taught in a courtyard where almost no one was educated.

en: Now after seven years childless, Elizabeth grew hard, contacts with Katarina were cut
zh: 現在七年無子，伊麗莎白變得冷酷，與凱薩琳的聯繫被切斷
ja: 7年の間子供ができず、エリザベスは冷たくなり、カタリナとの連絡は断たれました。
local: Now after seven years childless, Elizabeth grew hard, contacts with Katarina were cut
native: Now after seven years childless, Elizabeth grew hard, contacts with Katarina were cut

en: off, letters censored.
zh: 中斷，信件被審查。
ja: 途絶え、手紙は検閲されました。
local: off, letters censored.
native: off, letters censored.

en: Pressure and a decision that would change everything, Katarina came to realize that if you
zh: 壓力和一個將改變一切的決定，凱薩琳開始意識到如果你
ja: プレッシャーとすべてを変える決断により、カタリナは気づきました、もしあなたが
local: Pressure and a decision that would change everything, Katarina came to realize that if you
native: Pressure and a decision that would change everything, Katarina came to realize that if you

en: have no protection, you must create your own.
zh: 沒有保護，你必須創造自己的保護。
ja: 保護がなければ、自分で作らなければならないと。
local: have no protection, you must create your own.
native: have no protection, you must create your own.

en: Sergey Seltikov, handsome, charming, attentive, the complete opposite of Peter.
zh: 謝爾蓋·塞爾蒂科夫，英俊、有魅力、細心，完全與彼得相反。
ja: セルゲイ・セルティコフ、ハンサムで魅力的、気配りがあり、ペーターとは正反対の人物。
local: Sergey Seltikov, handsome, charming, attentive, the complete opposite of Peter.
native: Sergey Seltikov, handsome, charming, attentive, the complete opposite of Peter.

en: Her ladies and hint hinted that the dynasty desperately needed an heir.
zh: 她的侍女們暗示王朝迫切需要一個繼承人。
ja: 彼女の侍女たちは、王朝が必死に後継者を必要としているとほのめかしました。
local: Her ladies and hint hinted that the dynasty desperately needed an heir.
native: Her ladies and hint hinted that the dynasty desperately needed an heir.

en: Let him come from wherever.
zh: 讓他來自任何地方。
ja: どこから来ても構わない。
local: Let him come from wherever.
native: Let him come from wherever.

en: After nine years, Catherine Boris' son, Elizabeth took him instantly, paternity, a minor
zh: 九年後，凱薩琳·鮑里斯的兒子，伊麗莎白立刻接受了他，父親身份是次要的
ja: 9年後、エリザベスはキャサリン・ボリスの息子をすぐに受け入れました。父親であることは重要ではありませんでした。
local: After nine years, Catherine Boris' son, Elizabeth took him instantly, paternity, a minor
native: After nine years, Catherine Boris' son, Elizabeth took him instantly, paternity, a minor

en: matter.
zh: 問題。
ja: 問題でした。
local: matter.
native: matter.

en: The throne was secured, Seltikov was elegantly sent out of the country.
zh: 王位得以保障，塞爾蒂科夫被優雅地驅逐出國。
ja: 王位は確保され、セルティコフは優雅に国外追放されました。
local: The throne was secured, Seltikov was elegantly sent out of the country.
native: The throne was secured, Seltikov was elegantly sent out of the country.

en: In this time of loneliness, Catherine found a new mentor, the English ambassador Charles
zh: 在這孤獨的時期，凱薩琳找到了新的導師，英國大使查爾斯
ja: この孤独な時期に、カタリナは新しいメンター、イギリス大使チャールズを見つけました。
local: In this time of loneliness, Catherine found a new mentor, the English ambassador Charles
native: In this time of loneliness, Catherine found a new mentor, the English ambassador Charles

en: Henry Williams.
zh: 亨利·威廉斯。
ja: ヘンリー・ウィリアムズ。
local: Henry Williams.
native: Henry Williams.

en: Williams was not only a diplomat, but also a man who recognized Catherine's potential.
zh: 威廉斯不僅是外交官，還是一個認識到凱薩琳潛力的人。
ja: ウィリアムズは外交官であるだけでなく、カタリナの潜在能力を認める人物でもありました。
local: Williams was not only a diplomat, but also a man who recognized Catherine's potential.
native: Williams was not only a diplomat, but also a man who recognized Catherine's potential.

en: She gained an intense image of Western Europe through this relationship.
zh: 她通過這段關係獲得了對西歐的深刻印象。
ja: 彼女はこの関係を通じて西ヨーロッパの強烈なイメージを得ました。
local: She gained an intense image of Western Europe through this relationship.
native: She gained an intense image of Western Europe through this relationship.

en: The ambassador also strengthened Catherine's hunger for power and saw in her a future ally
zh: 大使也加強了凱薩琳對權力的渴望，並將她視為未來的盟友
ja: 大使はまた、カタリナの権力への渇望を強め、彼女を将来の同盟者と見なしました。
local: The ambassador also strengthened Catherine's hunger for power and saw in her a future ally
native: The ambassador also strengthened Catherine's hunger for power and saw in her a future ally

en: of his country.
zh: 他的國家。
ja: 彼の国の。
local: of his country.
native: of his country.

en: Catherine firmly rejected the diplomats' advances.
zh: 凱薩琳堅決拒絕了外交官的追求。
ja: カタリナは外交官たちの接近を断固として拒否しました。
local: Catherine firmly rejected the diplomats' advances.
native: Catherine firmly rejected the diplomats' advances.

en: She was shrewd enough to grasp that a romantic entanglement with a foreign ambassador would
zh: 她足夠精明，明白與外國大使的浪漫糾葛將會
ja: 彼女は賢明にも、外国大使との恋愛関係が
local: She was shrewd enough to grasp that a romantic entanglement with a foreign ambassador would
native: She was shrewd enough to grasp that a romantic entanglement with a foreign ambassador would

en: have amounted to political suicide.
zh: 等同於政治自殺。
ja: 政治的自殺に等しいことを理解していました。
local: have amounted to political suicide.
native: have amounted to political suicide.

en: Although they didn't write love letters to each other, the correspondence was very emotional.
zh: 雖然他們沒有互寫情書，但通信非常感性。
ja: 彼らは愛の手紙を交換しませんでしたが、やり取りは非常に感情的でした。
local: Although they didn't write love letters to each other, the correspondence was very emotional.
native: Although they didn't write love letters to each other, the correspondence was very emotional.

en: Williams lent Katarina the then enormous sum of £100,000, a dangerous business.
zh: 威廉斯借給凱薩琳當時龐大的10萬英鎊，這是一筆危險的交易。
ja: ウィリアムズはカタリナに当時としては莫大な10万ポンドを貸しました。危険な取引でした。
local: Williams lent Katarina the then enormous sum of £100,000, a dangerous business.
native: Williams lent Katarina the then enormous sum of £100,000, a dangerous business.

en: Janislav Ponyatowski, William Secretary, yes, a Polish count, clever, educated, his equal.
zh: 雅尼斯拉夫·波尼亞托夫斯基，威廉的秘書，是一位波蘭伯爵，聰明、有學識，與他平起平坐。
ja: ヤニスラフ・ポニャトフスキ、ウィリアムの秘書であり、ポーランドの伯爵、賢く教養があり、彼の対等な存在でした。
local: Janislav Ponyatowski, William Secretary, yes, a Polish count, clever, educated, his equal.
native: Janislav Ponyatowski, William Secretary, yes, a Polish count, clever, educated, his equal.

en: The probably happiest relationship of her life and at the same time politically sensitive.
zh: 她一生中可能最幸福的關係，同時也是政治敏感的。
ja: おそらく彼女の人生で最も幸せな関係であり、同時に政治的に敏感なものでした。
local: The probably happiest relationship of her life and at the same time politically sensitive.
native: The probably happiest relationship of her life and at the same time politically sensitive.

en: Secret letters, discreet messengers.
zh: 秘密信件，謹慎的信使。
ja: 秘密の手紙、慎重な使者たち。
local: Secret letters, discreet messengers.
native: Secret letters, discreet messengers.

en: In 1756, the Seven Years' War began, Prussia and Britain against Russia, Austria, France.
zh: 1756年，七年戰爭開始，普魯士和英國對抗俄羅斯、奧地利、法國。
ja: 1756年、七年戦争が始まり、プロイセンとイギリスがロシア、オーストリア、フランスと戦いました。
local: In 1756, the Seven Years' War began, Prussia and Britain against Russia, Austria, France.
native: In 1756, the Seven Years' War began, Prussia and Britain against Russia, Austria, France.

en: Williams became an adversary and yet continued to be a correspondent.
zh: 威廉斯成為了對手，但仍繼續保持通信。
ja: ウィリアムズは敵対者となりましたが、それでも通信を続けました。
local: Williams became an adversary and yet continued to be a correspondent.
native: Williams became an adversary and yet continued to be a correspondent.

en: Katarina was expecting a child from Ponyatowski.
zh: 凱薩琳懷了波尼亞托夫斯基的孩子。
ja: カタリナはポニャトフスキの子を妊娠していました。
local: Katarina was expecting a child from Ponyatowski.
native: Katarina was expecting a child from Ponyatowski.

en: In December 1757, Katarina gave birth to a daughter.
zh: 1757年12月，凱薩琳生下一個女兒。
ja: 1757年12月、カタリナは娘を出産しました。
local: In December 1757, Katarina gave birth to a daughter.
native: In December 1757, Katarina gave birth to a daughter.

en: Once again, the Sarina immediately took the child away and baptized her Anna Petrovna
zh: 薩琳娜再次立即帶走孩子，並給她施洗名為安娜·彼得羅芙娜
ja: 再びサリーナはすぐに子供を連れて行き、アンナ・ペトロヴナと洗礼を授けました。
local: Once again, the Sarina immediately took the child away and baptized her Anna Petrovna
native: Once again, the Sarina immediately took the child away and baptized her Anna Petrovna

en: without consulting Katarina.
zh: 未經凱薩琳同意。
ja: カタリナに相談せずに。
local: without consulting Katarina.
native: without consulting Katarina.

en: Only two years later, the little girl died.
zh: 僅兩年後，小女孩去世了。
ja: わずか2年後、その少女は亡くなりました。
local: Only two years later, the little girl died.
native: Only two years later, the little girl died.

en: Katarina lost not only her lover, but also her child.
zh: 凱薩琳失去了她的愛人，也失去了她的孩子。
ja: カタリナは恋人だけでなく、子供も失いました。
local: Katarina lost not only her lover, but also her child.
native: Katarina lost not only her lover, but also her child.

en: Sarina Elizabeth sent her army against Frederick the Great.
zh: 薩琳娜·伊麗莎白派遣軍隊對抗腓特烈大帝。
ja: サリーナ・エリザベスはフリードリヒ大王に対して軍隊を送りました。
local: Sarina Elizabeth sent her army against Frederick the Great.
native: Sarina Elizabeth sent her army against Frederick the Great.

en: Russia declared war on Prussia and thus also on its ally, Great Britain.
zh: 俄羅斯對普魯士宣戰，因此也對其盟友大不列顛宣戰。
ja: ロシアはプロイセンに宣戦布告し、それにより同盟国のイギリスにも宣戦布告しました。
local: Russia declared war on Prussia and thus also on its ally, Great Britain.
native: Russia declared war on Prussia and thus also on its ally, Great Britain.

en: Suddenly the English ambassador Charles Henry Williams was no longer Katarina's friend,
zh: 突然間，英國大使查爾斯·亨利·威廉斯不再是凱薩琳的朋友，
ja: 突然、イギリス大使チャールズ・ヘンリー・ウィリアムズはカタリナの友人ではなくなりました。
local: Suddenly the English ambassador Charles Henry Williams was no longer Katarina's friend,
native: Suddenly the English ambassador Charles Henry Williams was no longer Katarina's friend,

en: but the representative of a hostile power.
zh: 而是敵對勢力的代表。
ja: 敵対する勢力の代表となりました。
local: but the representative of a hostile power.
native: but the representative of a hostile power.

en: Despite hostilities between Prussia and Britain, Katarina kept writing the English ambassador
zh: 儘管普魯士和英國之間存在敵對，凱薩琳仍繼續給英國大使寫信
ja: プロイセンとイギリスの敵対関係にもかかわらず、カタリナはイギリス大使に書き続けました。
local: Despite hostilities between Prussia and Britain, Katarina kept writing the English ambassador
native: Despite hostilities between Prussia and Britain, Katarina kept writing the English ambassador

en: about court sentiment and politics.
zh: 關於宮廷情緒和政治。
ja: 宮廷の感情と政治について。
local: about court sentiment and politics.
ja_pron: Kyūtei no kanjō to seiji ni tsuite.
native: about court sentiment and politics.

en: Borderline, high treason.
zh: 邊緣，叛國罪。
ja: 境界線上の重罪、反逆罪。
local: Borderline, high treason.
ja_pron: Kyōkaisen-jō no jūzai, hangyaku-zai.
native: Borderline, high treason.

en: When the ambassador's 100,000 pounds were used up, Katarina asked for money again.
zh: 當大使的十萬英鎊用完時，卡塔琳娜再次要求資金。
ja: 大使の10万ポンドが使い果たされたとき、カタリナは再び資金を求めた。
local: When the ambassador's 100,000 pounds were used up, Katarina asked for money again.
ja_pron: Taishi no jūman pondo ga tsukaihatasa reta toki, Katarina wa futatabi shikin o motometa.
native: When the ambassador's 100,000 pounds were used up, Katarina asked for money again.

en: Even though she was fully aware of the grave danger, she wrote,
zh: 即使她完全意識到嚴重的危險，她仍寫道，
ja: 彼女は重大な危険を十分に認識していたにもかかわらず、こう書いた。
local: Even though she was fully aware of the grave danger, she wrote,
ja_pron: Kanojo wa jūdaina kiken o jūbun ni ninshiki shite ita ni mo kakawarazu, kō kaita.
native: Even though she was fully aware of the grave danger, she wrote,

en: If it is at all possible, please make available to me a sum equal to the amount I've already
zh: 如果可能，請提供給我一筆與我已經收到的金額相等的款項。
ja: もし可能なら、私がすでに受け取った金額と同じ額を用意してください。
local: If it is at all possible, please make available to me a sum equal to the amount I've already
ja_pron: Moshi kanō nara, watashi ga sudeni uketotta kingaku to onaji gaku o yōi shite kudasai.
native: If it is at all possible, please make available to me a sum equal to the amount I've already

en: received.
zh: 收到的。
ja: 受け取った。
local: received.
ja_pron: Uketotta.
native: received.

en: If it's possible, carry this out in a manner that's even more secretive than the first time.
zh: 如果可能，請以比第一次更秘密的方式進行。
ja: 可能なら、これを最初よりもさらに秘密裏に行ってください。
local: If it's possible, carry this out in a manner that's even more secretive than the first time.
ja_pron: Kanō nara, kore o saisho yori mo sara ni himitsuri ni okonatte kudasai.
native: If it's possible, carry this out in a manner that's even more secretive than the first time.

en: After defeating Prussia, General Abraxen suddenly ordered a retreat.
zh: 擊敗普魯士後，阿布拉克森將軍突然下令撤退。
ja: プロイセンを打ち負かした後、アブラクセン将軍は突然撤退を命じた。
local: After defeating Prussia, General Abraxen suddenly ordered a retreat.
ja_pron: Puroisen o uchimakashita ato, Aburakusen shōgun wa totsuzen tettai o meijita.
native: After defeating Prussia, General Abraxen suddenly ordered a retreat.

en: Library, English influence, Catherine's letters were partially intercepted, Elizabeth summoned
zh: 圖書館，英國影響，凱瑟琳的信件部分被截獲，伊莉莎白召見了
ja: 図書館、イギリスの影響、カトリーヌの手紙が一部傍受され、エリザベスは召喚した
local: Library, English influence, Catherine's letters were partially intercepted, Elizabeth summoned
ja_pron: Toshokan, Igirisu no eikyō, Katorīnu no tegami ga ichibu bōju sare, Erizabesu wa shōkan shita
native: Library, English influence, Catherine's letters were partially intercepted, Elizabeth summoned

en: Catherine in the middle of the night.
zh: 凱瑟琳在半夜被召見。
ja: カトリーヌは夜中に召喚された。
local: Catherine in the middle of the night.
ja_pron: Katorīnu wa yonaka ni shōkan sareta.
native: Catherine in the middle of the night.

en: Behind the screens, secret police, courtiers, even Peter.
zh: 幕後，秘密警察、宮廷官員，甚至彼得。
ja: 幕の後ろには秘密警察、廷臣、そしてピーターさえもいた。
local: Behind the screens, secret police, courtiers, even Peter.
ja_pron: Maku no ushiro ni wa himitsu keisatsu, teishin, soshite Pītā sae mo ita.
native: Behind the screens, secret police, courtiers, even Peter.

en: Katarina threw herself at his feet, send me, if you wish, to step in, emotion, psychology,
zh: 卡塔琳娜跪倒在他腳下，如果你願意，派我介入，情感，心理學，
ja: カタリナは彼の足元にひざまずき、もし望むなら介入させてほしいと願った。感情、心理学、
local: Katarina threw herself at his feet, send me, if you wish, to step in, emotion, psychology,
ja_pron: Katarina wa kare no ashimoto ni hizamazuki, moshi nozomu nara kainyū sasete hoshii to negatta. Kanjō, shinrigaku,
native: Katarina threw herself at his feet, send me, if you wish, to step in, emotion, psychology,

en: wordcraft.
zh: 言辭技巧。
ja: 言葉の技術。
local: wordcraft.
ja_pron: Kotoba no gijutsu.
native: wordcraft.

en: Not her, Peter with his Prussian sympathies was the problem, Elizabeth believed her.
zh: 問題不是她，而是彼得與普魯士的同情，伊莉莎白相信了她。
ja: 問題は彼女ではなく、プロイセンに同情的なピーターだったとエリザベスは彼女を信じた。
local: Not her, Peter with his Prussian sympathies was the problem, Elizabeth believed her.
ja_pron: Mondai wa kanojo de wa naku, Puroisen ni dōjō-teki na Pītā datta to Erizabesu wa kanojo o shinjita.
native: Not her, Peter with his Prussian sympathies was the problem, Elizabeth believed her.

en: Katarina survived and gained stature.
zh: 卡塔琳娜倖存並獲得地位。
ja: カタリナは生き延び、地位を得た。
local: Katarina survived and gained stature.
ja_pron: Katarina wa ikinobi, chii o eta.
native: Katarina survived and gained stature.

en: Winning alone isn't enough, you need allies.
zh: 單靠勝利是不夠的，你需要盟友。
ja: 勝つだけでは十分ではなく、味方が必要だ。
local: Winning alone isn't enough, you need allies.
ja_pron: Katsu dake de wa jūbun de wa naku, mikata ga hitsuyō da.
native: Winning alone isn't enough, you need allies.

en: Gregory Orlov, War Hero, Daredevil, a surprisingly clear mind, it was love and a connection
zh: 格雷戈里·奧爾洛夫，戰爭英雄，敢死隊員，意外地清晰的頭腦，那是愛與聯繫
ja: グレゴリー・オルロフ、戦争の英雄、無鉄砲者、驚くほど明晰な頭脳、それは愛と繋がりだった。
local: Gregory Orlov, War Hero, Daredevil, a surprisingly clear mind, it was love and a connection
ja_pron: Guregorī Orurofu, sensō no eiyū, mutteppōsha, odoroku hodo meiseki na zunō, sore wa ai to tsunagari datta.
native: Gregory Orlov, War Hero, Daredevil, a surprisingly clear mind, it was love and a connection

en: to the guard.
zh: 與衛隊的聯繫。
ja: 衛兵との繋がりだった。
local: to the guard.
ja_pron: Eihei to no tsunagari datta.
native: to the guard.

en: His brothers held key positions, the guard regiments, Russia's true king-makers.
zh: 他的兄弟們掌握重要職位，衛隊團，俄羅斯真正的權力製造者。
ja: 彼の兄弟たちは重要な地位を占め、衛兵連隊、ロシアの真の権力者だった。
local: His brothers held key positions, the guard regiments, Russia's true king-makers.
ja_pron: Kare no kyōdai-tachi wa jūyō na chii o shime, eihen rentai, Roshia no shin no kenryokusha datta.
native: His brothers held key positions, the guard regiments, Russia's true king-makers.

en: Orlov truly possessed the mind of a statesman, I have never seen anyone grasp everything
zh: 奧爾洛夫真正擁有政治家的頭腦，我從未見過有人能如此迅速掌握一切
ja: オルロフは真に政治家の頭脳を持っており、私はこれほど迅速に全てを把握する人を見たことがない。
local: Orlov truly possessed the mind of a statesman, I have never seen anyone grasp everything
ja_pron: Orurofu wa makoto ni seijika no zunō o motte ori, watashi wa kore hodo jinsoku ni subete o haaku suru hito o mita koto ga nai.
native: Orlov truly possessed the mind of a statesman, I have never seen anyone grasp everything

en: he does quite so quickly.
zh: 他能如此迅速地做到。
ja: 彼がこれほど速く理解するのを見たことがない。
local: he does quite so quickly.
ja_pron: Kare ga kore hodo hayaku rikai suru no o mita koto ga nai.
native: he does quite so quickly.

en: He immediately sees both sides of the problem and the solutions flow from his mouth like
zh: 他立刻看到問題的雙方，解決方案如瀑布般從他口中流出
ja: 彼は問題の両面を即座に見抜き、解決策が滝のように口から流れ出る。
local: He immediately sees both sides of the problem and the solutions flow from his mouth like
ja_pron: Kare wa mondai no ryōmen o sokuza ni minuki, kaiketsusaku ga taki no yō ni kuchi kara nagaredasu.
native: He immediately sees both sides of the problem and the solutions flow from his mouth like

en: a waterfall.
zh: 瀑布。
ja: 滝のように。
local: a waterfall.
ja_pron: Taki no yō ni.
native: a waterfall.

en: Orlov was not only handsome and strong, but also intelligent, and Gregori was not alone.
zh: 奧爾洛夫不僅英俊強壯，而且聰明，格雷戈里並非孤單一人。
ja: オルロフはハンサムで強いだけでなく、知的でもあり、グレゴリは一人ではなかった。
local: Orlov was not only handsome and strong, but also intelligent, and Gregori was not alone.
ja_pron: Orurofu wa hansamu de tsuyoi dake de naku, chiteki demo ari, Guregori wa hitori de wa nakatta.
native: Orlov was not only handsome and strong, but also intelligent, and Gregori was not alone.

en: He belonged to a family of five brothers who all served in the guard and had great influence
zh: 他屬於一個有五兄弟的家庭，全部在衛隊服役並擁有巨大影響力
ja: 彼は5人兄弟の家族に属し、全員が衛兵に勤務し大きな影響力を持っていた。
local: He belonged to a family of five brothers who all served in the guard and had great influence
ja_pron: Kare wa gonin kyōdai no kazoku ni zoku shi, zen'in ga eihen ni kinmu shi ōkina eikyōryoku o motte ita.
native: He belonged to a family of five brothers who all served in the guard and had great influence

en: in their regiments.
zh: 在他們的團裡。
ja: 彼らの連隊で。
local: in their regiments.
ja_pron: Karera no rentai de.
native: in their regiments.

en: The Orlov brothers controlled crucial parts of the guard, the elite troops who decided
zh: 奧爾洛夫兄弟掌控衛隊的關鍵部分，這些精銳部隊決定了
ja: オルロフ兄弟は衛兵の重要な部分を支配し、その精鋭部隊が決定した。
local: The Orlov brothers controlled crucial parts of the guard, the elite troops who decided
ja_pron: Orurofu kyōdai wa eihen no jūyō na bubun o shihai shi, sono seiei butai ga kettei shita.
native: The Orlov brothers controlled crucial parts of the guard, the elite troops who decided

en: the fate of the Zars.
zh: 沙皇的命運。
ja: ツァーリの運命を。
local: the fate of the Zars.
ja_pron: Tsāri no unmei o.
native: the fate of the Zars.

en: Their support was absolutely critical for anyone who wanted to rule in Russia.
zh: 他們的支持對於任何想在俄羅斯統治的人來說都是絕對關鍵的。
ja: 彼らの支持はロシアで支配したい者にとって絶対に重要だった。
local: Their support was absolutely critical for anyone who wanted to rule in Russia.
ja_pron: Karera no shiji wa Roshia de shihaishitai mono ni totte zettai ni jūyō datta.
native: Their support was absolutely critical for anyone who wanted to rule in Russia.

en: The Empress Elizabeth fell ill, died in early 1762.
zh: 女皇伊莉莎白生病，於1762年初去世。
ja: エリザベス女帝は病に倒れ、1762年初頭に亡くなった。
local: The Empress Elizabeth fell ill, died in early 1762.
ja_pron: Erizabesu jotei wa yamai ni taore, 1762-nen shotō ni nakunatta.
native: The Empress Elizabeth fell ill, died in early 1762.

en: At the funeral, Peter didn't shed a tear.
zh: 在葬禮上，彼得沒有流淚。
ja: 葬儀でピーターは涙を流さなかった。
local: At the funeral, Peter didn't shed a tear.
ja_pron: Sōgi de Pītā wa namida o nagasanakatta.
native: At the funeral, Peter didn't shed a tear.

en: Katarina was pregnant by Orlov and cautious.
zh: 卡塔琳娜懷了奧爾洛夫的孩子，且很謹慎。
ja: カタリナはオルロフの子を妊娠しており、慎重だった。
local: Katarina was pregnant by Orlov and cautious.
ja_pron: Katarina wa Orurofu no ko o ninshin shite ori, shinchō datta.
native: Katarina was pregnant by Orlov and cautious.

en: Peter ended the war in Prussia's favor.
zh: 彼得結束了對普魯士有利的戰爭。
ja: ピーターはプロイセンに有利な形で戦争を終えた。
local: Peter ended the war in Prussia's favor.
ja_pron: Pītā wa Puroisen ni yūri na katachi de sensō o oeta.
native: Peter ended the war in Prussia's favor.

en: He put Russian troops in Prussian uniforms, favored German courtiers, confiscated church
zh: 他讓俄羅斯軍穿上普魯士制服，偏袒德國宮廷官員，沒收教會
ja: 彼はロシア軍にプロイセンの制服を着せ、ドイツの廷臣を優遇し、教会を没収した。
local: He put Russian troops in Prussian uniforms, favored German courtiers, confiscated church
ja_pron: Kare wa Roshia-gun ni Puroisen no seifuku o kise, Doitsu no teishin o yūgū shi, kyōkai o bosshū shita.
native: He put Russian troops in Prussian uniforms, favored German courtiers, confiscated church

en: property.
zh: 財產。
ja: 財産を。
local: property.
ja_pron: Zaisan o.
native: property.

en: He alienated everyone, nobility, army, church, people.
zh: 他疏遠了所有人，貴族、軍隊、教會、人民。
ja: 彼はすべての人々、貴族、軍隊、教会、民衆を疎外した。
local: He alienated everyone, nobility, army, church, people.
ja_pron: Kare wa subete no hitobito, kizoku, guntai, kyōkai, minshū o sogai shita.
native: He alienated everyone, nobility, army, church, people.

en: The Orlov's plotted the coup with officers.
zh: 奧爾洛夫家族與軍官密謀政變。
ja: オルロフ家は将校たちと共にクーデターを計画した。
local: The Orlov's plotted the coup with officers.
ja_pron: Orurofu-ke wa shōkō-tachi to tomo ni kūdetā o keikaku shita.
native: The Orlov's plotted the coup with officers.

en: Political dynamite, Peter's plan to march against Denmark gave the final push.
zh: 政治炸藥，彼得對丹麥進軍的計劃給了最後一擊。
ja: 政治的な爆弾、ピーターのデンマークへの進軍計画が最後の一押しとなった。
local: Political dynamite, Peter's plan to march against Denmark gave the final push.
ja_pron: Seijiteki na bakudan, Pītā no Denmāku e no shingun keikaku ga saigo no ichi oshi to natta.
native: Political dynamite, Peter's plan to march against Denmark gave the final push.

en: A public scandal.
zh: 一場公開醜聞。
ja: 公のスキャンダル。
local: A public scandal.
ja_pron: Ōyake no sukyandaru.
native: A public scandal.

en: Peter's threat to banished Katarina now left absolutely no turning back.
zh: 彼得威脅要放逐卡塔琳娜，現在已經無法回頭。
ja: ピーターのカタリナ追放の脅しは、もはや絶対に後戻りできない状況を作った。
local: Peter's threat to banished Katarina now left absolutely no turning back.
ja_pron: Pītā no Katarina tsuihō no odoshi wa, mohaya zettai ni atomodori dekinai jōkyō o tsukutta.
native: Peter's threat to banished Katarina now left absolutely no turning back.

en: An accomplice in the planned coup was arrested.
zh: 政變計劃中的同謀被逮捕。
ja: 計画されたクーデターの共犯者が逮捕された。
local: An accomplice in the planned coup was arrested.
ja_pron: Keikaku sareta kūdetā no kyōhansha ga taiho sareta.
native: An accomplice in the planned coup was arrested.

en: Alexei Orlov woke Katarina at the break of dawn.
zh: 阿列克謝·奧爾洛夫在黎明時喚醒了卡塔琳娜。
ja: アレクセイ・オルロフは夜明けにカタリナを起こした。
local: Alexei Orlov woke Katarina at the break of dawn.
ja_pron: Arekusei Orurofu wa yoake ni Katarina o okoshita.
native: Alexei Orlov woke Katarina at the break of dawn.

en: Now we have to strike or will hang.
zh: 現在我們必須行動，否則將被絞死。
ja: 今こそ行動しなければ、絞首刑になる。
local: Now we have to strike or will hang.
ja_pron: Ima koso kōdō shinakereba, kōshukei ni naru.
native: Now we have to strike or will hang.

en: Katarina drove into the city without a perfect script, but with courage.
zh: 卡塔琳娜沒有完美的計劃，但帶著勇氣駛入城市。
ja: カタリナは完璧な計画なしに、しかし勇気を持って街に乗り込んだ。
local: Katarina drove into the city without a perfect script, but with courage.
ja_pron: Katarina wa kanpeki na keikaku nashi ni, shikashi yūki o motte machi ni norikonda.
native: Katarina drove into the city without a perfect script, but with courage.

en: Her first stop was at the Ismailovsky Regiment, where she denounced Peter as a danger to Russia
zh: 她的第一站是伊斯梅洛夫斯基團，在那裡她譴責彼得是俄羅斯的危險。
ja: 彼女の最初の停車地はイスマイロフスキー連隊で、そこでピーターをロシアの危険人物として非難した。
local: Her first stop was at the Ismailovsky Regiment, where she denounced Peter as a danger to Russia
ja_pron: Kanojo no saisho no teishachi wa Isumairofusukī rentai de, soko de Pītā o Roshia no kiken jinbutsu to shite hinan shita.
native: Her first stop was at the Ismailovsky Regiment, where she denounced Peter as a danger to Russia

en: and declared herself its rescuer.
zh: 並宣稱自己是救援者。
ja: そして自らを救済者と宣言した。
local: and declared herself its rescuer.
ja_pron: Soshite mizukara o kyūsai-sha to sengen shita.
native: and declared herself its rescuer.

en: A guardsman's uniform, a steely gaze, few words, the soldiers knelt calling her little
zh: 一身衛兵制服，堅定的目光，寡言，士兵們跪地稱她為小母親
ja: 衛兵の制服、鋼のような視線、少ない言葉、兵士たちはひざまずき彼女を「リトルマザー」と呼んだ。
local: A guardsman's uniform, a steely gaze, few words, the soldiers knelt calling her little
ja_pron: Eihei no seifuku, hagane no yō na shisen, sukunai kotoba, heishi-tachi wa hizamazuki kanojo o 'Ritoru Mazā' to yonda.
native: A guardsman's uniform, a steely gaze, few words, the soldiers knelt calling her little

en: mother.
zh: 母親。
ja: マザーと。
local: mother.
ja_pron: Mazā to.
native: mother.

en: Most after regiment came over.
zh: 大多數其他團也加入了。
ja: ほとんどの他の連隊も加わった。
local: Most after regiment came over.
ja_pron: Hotondo no hoka no rentai mo kuwawatta.
native: Most after regiment came over.

en: More than 12,000 people gathered in front of the winter palace.
zh: 超過12,000人聚集在冬宮前。
ja: 1万2千人以上が冬の宮殿の前に集まった。
local: More than 12,000 people gathered in front of the winter palace.
ja_pron: Ichiman nisen nin ijō ga fuyu no kyūden no mae ni atsumatta.
native: More than 12,000 people gathered in front of the winter palace.

en: Katarina stepped onto the balcony, tears, Catherine of all the Russia's discipline instead
zh: 卡塔琳娜走上陽台，淚水，俄羅斯所有的紀律代替了
ja: カタリナはバルコニーに足を踏み入れ、涙を流した。ロシアのすべての規律が代わりにあった。
local: Katarina stepped onto the balcony, tears, Catherine of all the Russia's discipline instead
ja_pron: Katarina wa barukonī ni ashi o fumiire, namida o nagashita. Roshia no subete no kiritsu ga kawari ni atta.
native: Katarina stepped onto the balcony, tears, Catherine of all the Russia's discipline instead

en: of looting, a revolution without blood, for now.
zh: 掠奪，暫時無血革命。
ja: 略奪の代わりに、今のところ血のない革命だった。
local: of looting, a revolution without blood, for now.
ja_pron: Ryaku-datsu no kawari ni, ima no tokoro chi no nai kakumei datta.
native: of looting, a revolution without blood, for now.

en: In less than 24 hours, Katarina became the Empress of all Russia, the army that people
zh: 不到24小時，卡塔琳娜成為全俄羅斯的女皇，軍隊和人民
ja: 24時間も経たずに、カタリナは全ロシアの女帝となり、軍隊と民衆が
local: In less than 24 hours, Katarina became the Empress of all Russia, the army that people
ja_pron: 24-jikan mo tatanai uchi ni, Katarina wa zen Roshia no jotei to nari, guntai to minshū ga
native: In less than 24 hours, Katarina became the Empress of all Russia, the army that people

en: with the nobility stood behind her.
zh: 與貴族一起支持她。
ja: 貴族と共に彼女を支えた。
local: with the nobility stood behind her.
ja_pron: Kizoku to tomo ni kanojo o sasaeta.
native: with the nobility stood behind her.

en: Peter was completely surprised by the revolt.
zh: 彼得對這場叛亂完全感到驚訝。
ja: ピーターは反乱に完全に驚いた。
local: Peter was completely surprised by the revolt.
ja_pron: Pītā wa hanran ni kanzen ni odoroita.
native: Peter was completely surprised by the revolt.

en: He hadn't recognized the signs of the times and was unprepared for what happened.
zh: 他沒有察覺時代的徵兆，對發生的事毫無準備。
ja: 彼は時代の兆候を認識せず、起こったことに備えていなかった。
local: He hadn't recognized the signs of the times and was unprepared for what happened.
ja_pron: Kare wa jidai no chōkō o ninshiki sezu, okotta koto ni sonaete inakatta.
native: He hadn't recognized the signs of the times and was unprepared for what happened.

en: Two days later, he allowed himself to be arrested without resistance.
zh: 兩天後，他允許自己無抵抗地被逮捕。
ja: 2日後、彼は抵抗せずに逮捕されることを許した。
local: Two days later, he allowed himself to be arrested without resistance.
ja_pron: Futsuka go, kare wa teikō sezu ni taiho sareru koto o yurushita.
native: Two days later, he allowed himself to be arrested without resistance.

en: The man who had begun as an all-powerful czar surrendered.
zh: 那位曾是全能沙皇的人投降了。
ja: かつて全能のツァーリだった男が降伏した。
local: The man who had begun as an all-powerful czar surrendered.
ja_pron: Katsute zennō no Tsāri datta otoko ga kōfuku shita.
native: The man who had begun as an all-powerful czar surrendered.

en: Peter's abdication signaled the end of one of the shortest and most catastrophic rains
zh: 彼得的退位標誌著俄羅斯歷史上最短且最災難性的統治之一的結束
ja: ピーターの退位は、ロシア史上最も短く最悪の治世の一つの終わりを告げた。
local: Peter's abdication signaled the end of one of the shortest and most catastrophic rains
ja_pron: Pītā no taii wa, Roshia-shi jō mottomo mijikaku saiaku no chisei no hitotsu no owari o tsugeta.
native: Peter's abdication signaled the end of one of the shortest and most catastrophic rains

en: in all of Russian history.
zh: 在整個俄羅斯歷史上。
ja: ロシアの歴史全体で。
local: in all of Russian history.
ja_pron: Roshia no rekishi zentai de.
native: in all of Russian history.

en: He signed the abdication document and requested permission to depart from Russia.
zh: 他簽署了退位文件並請求離開俄羅斯的許可。
ja: 彼は退位文書に署名し、ロシアからの出国許可を求めた。
local: He signed the abdication document and requested permission to depart from Russia.
ja_pron: Kare wa taii bunsho ni shomei shi, Roshia kara no shukkoku kyoka o motometa.
native: He signed the abdication document and requested permission to depart from Russia.

en: St. Petersburg, winter 1762.
zh: 聖彼得堡，1762年冬季。
ja: サンクトペテルブルク、1762年冬。
local: St. Petersburg, winter 1762.
ja_pron: Sankutopeteruburuku, 1762-nen fuyu.
native: St. Petersburg, winter 1762.

en: Catherine was now Serena of Russia, but her rain was far from secure.
zh: 凱瑟琳娜現在是俄羅斯的女皇，但她的統治遠未穩固。
ja: カトリナは今やロシアの女帝だったが、その統治は決して安定していなかった。
local: Catherine was now Serena of Russia, but her rain was far from secure.
ja_pron: Katorina wa imaya Roshia no jotei datta ga, sono tōchi wa kesshite antei shite inakatta.
native: Catherine was now Serena of Russia, but her rain was far from secure.

en: The coup had succeeded, but the plotting and scheming had only just begun.
zh: 政變成功了，但陰謀和策劃才剛剛開始。
ja: クーデターは成功したが、陰謀と策略は始まったばかりだった。
local: The coup had succeeded, but the plotting and scheming had only just begun.
ja_pron: Kūdetā wa seikō shita ga, inbō to sakuryaku wa hajimatta bakari datta.
native: The coup had succeeded, but the plotting and scheming had only just begun.

en: The old networks of her murdered husband were forming at court, influential nobles,
zh: 她被謀殺丈夫的舊勢力正在宮廷形成，有影響力的貴族，
ja: 殺された夫の古い勢力が宮廷で形成されつつあり、影響力のある貴族たち、
local: The old networks of her murdered husband were forming at court, influential nobles,
ja_pron: Korosareta otto no furui seiryoku ga kyūtei de keisei saretsutsu ari, eikyōryoku no aru kizoku-tachi,
native: The old networks of her murdered husband were forming at court, influential nobles,

en: generals, court officials.
zh: 將軍，宮廷官員。
ja: 将軍、宮廷役人。
local: generals, court officials.
ja_pron: Shōgun, kyūtei yakunin.
native: generals, court officials.

en: She doubted her legitimacy.
zh: 她懷疑自己的合法性。
ja: 彼女は自分の正当性を疑った。
local: She doubted her legitimacy.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa jibun no seitōsei o utagatta.
native: She doubted her legitimacy.

en: Catherine stood utterly alone as a German princess on the Russian imperial throne.
zh: 卡塔琳娜作為一位德國公主，孤身站在俄羅斯帝國的王位上。
ja: カタリナはドイツの王女として、ロシア帝国の玉座に完全に一人で立っていた。
local: Catherine stood utterly alone as a German princess on the Russian imperial throne.
ja_pron: Katarina wa Doitsu no ōjo to shite, Roshia teikoku no gyokuza ni kanzen ni hitori de tatte ita.
native: Catherine stood utterly alone as a German princess on the Russian imperial throne.

en: With clever tact, political instinct and ice-cold calculation, she began to secure power.
zh: 憑藉聰明的策略、政治直覺和冷酷的計算，她開始鞏固權力。
ja: 巧みな策略、政治的本能、冷徹な計算で、彼女は権力を確立し始めた。
local: With clever tact, political instinct and ice-cold calculation, she began to secure power.
ja_pron: Takumi na sakuryaku, seijiteki hon'nō, reitetsu na keisan de, kanojo wa kenryoku o kakuritsu shi hajimeta.
native: With clever tact, political instinct and ice-cold calculation, she began to secure power.

en: She rewarded, threatened, negotiated.
zh: 她獎勵、威脅、談判。
ja: 彼女は報酬を与え、脅し、交渉した。
local: She rewarded, threatened, negotiated.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa hōshū o ata e, odoshi, kōshō shita.
native: She rewarded, threatened, negotiated.

en: She was no dreamer but a strategist, and she was aware of the greatest threat to her rule.
zh: 她不是夢想家，而是策略家，她知道對她統治最大的威脅是什麼。
ja: 彼女は夢想家ではなく戦略家であり、自分の支配に対する最大の脅威を認識していた。
local: She was no dreamer but a strategist, and she was aware of the greatest threat to her rule.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa musōka de wa naku senryakuka de ari, jibun no shiha i ni taisuru saidai no kyōi o ninshiki shite ita.
native: She was no dreamer but a strategist, and she was aware of the greatest threat to her rule.

en: Ive N. VI.
zh: 伊夫六世。
ja: イヴ6世。
local: Ive N. VI.
ja_pron: Ivu roku-sei.
native: Ive N. VI.

en: The former child emperor was still alive, imprisoned in the Schlisselberg fortress.
zh: 前任兒童皇帝仍然活著，被囚禁在施利塞爾堡要塞中。
ja: かつての子供皇帝はまだ生きており、シュリッセルベルク要塞に囚われていた。
local: The former child emperor was still alive, imprisoned in the Schlisselberg fortress.
ja_pron: Katsute no kodomo kōtei wa mada ikite ori, Shurisseruberuku yōsai ni torawarete ita.
native: The former child emperor was still alive, imprisoned in the Schlisselberg fortress.

en: He was the final legitimate czar and a perfect instrument for any adversary who sought
zh: 他是最後的合法沙皇，也是任何尋求
ja: 彼は最後の正当なツァーリであり、敵対者にとって完璧な道具だった。
local: He was the final legitimate czar and a perfect instrument for any adversary who sought
ja_pron: Kare wa saigo no seitō na Tsāri de ari, tekitaisha ni totte kanpeki na dōgu datta.
native: He was the final legitimate czar and a perfect instrument for any adversary who sought

en: to clip Catherine's wings.
zh: 削弱凱瑟琳的權力。
ja: カタリナの翼を切り落とすための。
local: to clip Catherine's wings.
ja_pron: Katarina no tsubasa o kiriotosu tame no.
native: to clip Catherine's wings.

en: For over 20 years, he had been kept hidden.
zh: 他被隱藏了超過20年。
ja: 20年以上も隠されていた。
local: For over 20 years, he had been kept hidden.
ja_pron: Nijū-nen ijō mo kakusarete ita.
native: For over 20 years, he had been kept hidden.

en: Catherine decided to see him with her own eyes.
zh: 卡塔琳娜決定親自見他一面。
ja: カタリナは自分の目で彼を見ることに決めた。
local: Catherine decided to see him with her own eyes.
ja_pron: Katarina wa jibun no me de kare o miru koto ni kimeta.
native: Catherine decided to see him with her own eyes.

en: Schlisselberg 1764.
zh: 施利塞爾堡，1764年。
ja: シュリッセルベルク、1764年。
local: Schlisselberg 1764.
ja_pron: Shurisseruberuku, 1764-nen.
native: Schlisselberg 1764.

en: The czarina entered the gloomy fortress and what she saw there made her shudder.
zh: 女沙皇進入陰暗的要塞，她所見讓她不寒而慄。
ja: 女帝は陰鬱な要塞に入り、そこで見たものに震え上がった。
local: The czarina entered the gloomy fortress and what she saw there made her shudder.
ja_pron: Jotei wa in'utsu na yōsai ni hairi, soko de mita mono ni furueagatta.
native: The czarina entered the gloomy fortress and what she saw there made her shudder.

en: Catherine was neither a madman nor a broken man.
zh: 卡塔琳娜既不是瘋子，也不是垮掉的人。
ja: カタリナは狂人でも壊れた人間でもなかった。
local: Catherine was neither a madman nor a broken man.
ja_pron: Katarina wa kyōjin demo kowareta ningen demo nakatta.
native: Catherine was neither a madman nor a broken man.

en: He was perfectly lucid and he recognized her instantly and without a doubt.
zh: 他神志清醒，立刻毫無疑問地認出了她。
ja: 彼は完全に正気で、彼女を即座に疑いなく認識しました。
local: He was perfectly lucid and he recognized her instantly and without a doubt.
ja_pron: Kare wa kanzen ni shōki de, kanojo o sokuzani utagai naku ninshiki shimashita.
native: He was perfectly lucid and he recognized her instantly and without a doubt.

en: He didn't speak often, but he knew exactly who he was and that he was the legitimate ruler.
zh: 他不常說話，但他非常清楚自己是誰，並且是合法的統治者。
ja: 彼はあまり話さなかったが、自分が誰であるか、正当な支配者であることを正確に知っていました。
local: He didn't speak often, but he knew exactly who he was and that he was the legitimate ruler.
ja_pron: Kare wa amari hanasanakatta ga, jibun ga dare de aru ka, seitōna shihaisha de aru koto o seikaku ni shitte imashita.
native: He didn't speak often, but he knew exactly who he was and that he was the legitimate ruler.

en: Catherine left the fortress and the decision had been made secretly, quietly, without public
zh: 凱薩琳離開了堡壘，決定是在秘密、安靜且沒有公開的情況下做出的
ja: エカチェリーナは要塞を離れ、その決定は秘密裏に、静かに、公にされることなく行われました。
local: Catherine left the fortress and the decision had been made secretly, quietly, without public
ja_pron: Ekacheriina wa yōsai o hanare, sono kettei wa himitsuri ni, shizuka ni, ōyake ni sareru koto naku okonawaremashita.
native: Catherine left the fortress and the decision had been made secretly, quietly, without public

en: spectacle.
zh: 的公開展示。
ja: 見世物として。
local: spectacle.
ja_pron: Misemono to shite.
native: spectacle.

en: His grave remains unknown to this day.
zh: 他的墳墓至今仍然未知。
ja: 彼の墓は今日まで不明のままです。
local: His grave remains unknown to this day.
ja_pron: Kare no haka wa kyō made fumei no mama desu.
native: His grave remains unknown to this day.

en: Gregory Orlov, soldier, daredevil, hero of the coup.
zh: 格雷戈里·奧爾洛夫，士兵、冒險家、政變英雄。
ja: グレゴリー・オルロフ、兵士、冒険家、クーデターの英雄。
local: Gregory Orlov, soldier, daredevil, hero of the coup.
ja_pron: Guregorī Orurofu, heishi, bōkenka, kūdetā no eiyū.
native: Gregory Orlov, soldier, daredevil, hero of the coup.

en: He had helped Catherine gain power and she had loved him.
zh: 他幫助凱薩琳獲得權力，而她也愛著他。
ja: 彼はエカチェリーナが権力を得るのを助け、彼女は彼を愛していました。
local: He had helped Catherine gain power and she had loved him.
ja_pron: Kare wa Ekacheriina ga kenryoku o eru no o tasuke, kanojo wa kare o aishite imashita.
native: He had helped Catherine gain power and she had loved him.

en: But over the years, the relationship became a burden.
zh: 但多年來，這段關係變成了一種負擔。
ja: しかし、年月が経つにつれて、その関係は重荷となりました。
local: But over the years, the relationship became a burden.
ja_pron: Shikashi, nengetsu ga tatsu ni tsurete, sono kankei wa omoni to narimashita.
native: But over the years, the relationship became a burden.

en: As early as 1762, she had a son, a Lexay.
zh: 早在1762年，她就有了一個兒子，名叫列克賽。
ja: 1762年にはすでに息子のレクサイがいました。
local: As early as 1762, she had a son, a Lexay.
ja_pron: 1762-nen ni wa sude ni musuko no Rekusai ga imashita.
native: As early as 1762, she had a son, a Lexay.

en: But not even the bond of their shared child held them together anymore.
zh: 但連他們共同孩子的羈絆也無法再將他們維繫在一起。
ja: しかし、共有する子供の絆さえも彼らを結びつけることはできませんでした。
local: But not even the bond of their shared child held them together anymore.
ja_pron: Shikashi, kyōyū suru kodomo no kizuna sae mo karera o musubitsukeru koto wa dekimasen deshita.
native: But not even the bond of their shared child held them together anymore.

en: She was just waiting for the right moment to break free.
zh: 她只是在等待合適的時機來解脫。
ja: 彼女はただ解放される適切な瞬間を待っていただけでした。
local: She was just waiting for the right moment to break free.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa tada kaihō sareru tekisetsu na shunkan o matte ita dake deshita.
native: She was just waiting for the right moment to break free.

en: Then came Potemkin, Gregory Alexander-Vitch, a guards officer, clever, well-read, charming.
zh: 然後來了波捷姆金，格雷戈里·亞歷山大維奇，一名警衛軍官，聰明、博學、有魅力。
ja: そしてポチョムキン、グレゴリー・アレクサンドルヴィッチが現れました。彼は警備隊の士官で、賢く、博識で魅力的でした。
local: Then came Potemkin, Gregory Alexander-Vitch, a guards officer, clever, well-read, charming.
ja_pron: Soshite Pochomukin, Guregorī Arekusandoruvitchi ga arawaremashita. Kare wa keibitai no shikan de, kashikoku, hakushiki de miryokuteki deshita.
native: Then came Potemkin, Gregory Alexander-Vitch, a guards officer, clever, well-read, charming.

en: People talked amongst themselves and there were quiet whispers circulating all throughout
zh: 人們私下交談，宮殿裡流傳著低聲耳語。
ja: 人々はひそひそ話を交わし、宮殿中に静かなささやきが広がっていました。
local: People talked amongst themselves and there were quiet whispers circulating all throughout
ja_pron: Hitobito wa hisohiso hanashi o kawashi, kyūdenjū ni shizuka na sasayaki ga hirogatte imashita.
native: People talked amongst themselves and there were quiet whispers circulating all throughout

en: the palace.
zh: 宮殿裡。
ja: 宮殿中に。
local: the palace.
ja_pron: Kyūdenjū ni.
native: the palace.

en: A formal public ceremony was completely out of the question.
zh: 正式的公開儀式完全不可能。
ja: 正式な公開式典は全く問題外でした。
local: A formal public ceremony was completely out of the question.
ja_pron: Seishiki na kōkai shikiten wa mattaku mondai-gai deshita.
native: A formal public ceremony was completely out of the question.

en: It simply could not be considered.
zh: 根本無法考慮。
ja: それは単純に考慮されることはありませんでした。
local: It simply could not be considered.
ja_pron: Sore wa tanjun ni kōryo sareru koto wa arimasen deshita.
native: It simply could not be considered.

en: She would have had to share her power and Catherine didn't do that with anyone.
zh: 她必須分享她的權力，但凱薩琳不會與任何人這麼做。
ja: 彼女は権力を分かち合わなければならなかったが、エカチェリーナは誰ともそうしませんでした。
local: She would have had to share her power and Catherine didn't do that with anyone.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kenryoku o wakachiawanakereba naranakatta ga, Ekacheriina wa dare to mo sō shimasen deshita.
native: She would have had to share her power and Catherine didn't do that with anyone.

en: What they did share with each other, however, was unique.
zh: 然而，他們彼此分享的是獨特的。
ja: しかし、彼らが互いに共有したものは独特でした。
local: What they did share with each other, however, was unique.
ja_pron: Shikashi, karera ga tagai ni kyōyū shita mono wa dokutoku deshita.
native: What they did share with each other, however, was unique.

en: It was a deeply passionate connection that manifested itself both in intensely physical
zh: 這是一種深刻熱情的聯繫，既體現在強烈的身體層面
ja: それは深く情熱的なつながりで、強烈な身体的側面にも現れていました。
local: It was a deeply passionate connection that manifested itself both in intensely physical
ja_pron: Sore wa fukaku jōnetsuteki na tsunagari de, kyōretsu na shintai-teki sokumen ni mo arawarete imashita.
native: It was a deeply passionate connection that manifested itself both in intensely physical

en: and profoundly political ways.
zh: 和深刻的政治方式中表現出來。
ja: そして深く政治的な形でも表れていました。
local: and profoundly political ways.
ja_pron: Soshite fukaku seijiteki na katachi demo arawarete imashita.
native: and profoundly political ways.

en: 1,775 Catherine gave birth to a daughter, Elisavetta, Potemkin's child.
zh: 1775年，凱薩琳生下了一個女兒，伊莉莎維塔，波捷姆金的孩子。
ja: 1775年、エカチェリーナは娘エリサヴェッタを出産しました。ポチョムキンの子供です。
local: 1,775 Catherine gave birth to a daughter, Elisavetta, Potemkin's child.
ja_pron: 1775-nen, Ekacheriina wa musume Erisavetta o shussan shimashita. Pochomukin no kodomo desu.
native: 1,775 Catherine gave birth to a daughter, Elisavetta, Potemkin's child.

en: But the public learned nothing of it.
zh: 但公眾一無所知。
ja: しかし、公には何も知らされませんでした。
local: But the public learned nothing of it.
ja_pron: Shikashi, ōyake ni wa nanimo shirasaremasen deshita.
native: But the public learned nothing of it.

en: The young girl grew up hidden under the protection of the Empress.
zh: 這個年輕女孩在女皇的保護下長大，隱藏起來。
ja: その若い少女は女帝の保護のもとで隠れて育ちました。
local: The young girl grew up hidden under the protection of the Empress.
ja_pron: Sono wakai shōjo wa jotei no hogo no moto de kakurete sodachimashita.
native: The young girl grew up hidden under the protection of the Empress.

en: Catherine knew, to be a great power, you must move borders.
zh: 凱薩琳知道，要成為強權，必須推動邊界。
ja: エカチェリーナは、偉大な権力になるには国境を動かさなければならないと知っていました。
local: Catherine knew, to be a great power, you must move borders.
ja_pron: Ekacheriina wa, idaina kenryoku ni naru ni wa kokkyō o ugokasanakereba naranai to shitte imashita.
native: Catherine knew, to be a great power, you must move borders.

en: As our Peter the Great fought for Russia's access to the Baltic Sea, now Catherine wanted
zh: 正如我們的彼得大帝為俄羅斯爭取波羅的海的通道，現在凱薩琳想要
ja: 私たちのピョートル大帝がロシアのバルト海へのアクセスのために戦ったように、今やエカチェリーナは
local: As our Peter the Great fought for Russia's access to the Baltic Sea, now Catherine wanted
ja_pron: Watashitachi no Pyōtoru Taitei ga Roshia no Baruto-kai e no akusesu no tame ni tatakatta yō ni, imaya Ekacheriina wa
native: As our Peter the Great fought for Russia's access to the Baltic Sea, now Catherine wanted

en: to conquer the south, the Black Sea, the Crimea, maybe even Constantinople.
zh: 征服南方、黑海、克里米亞，甚至可能是君士坦丁堡。
ja: 南方、黒海、クリミア、そしておそらくコンスタンティノープルを征服したいと思っていました。
local: to conquer the south, the Black Sea, the Crimea, maybe even Constantinople.
ja_pron: Nangata, Kurokai, Kurimia, soshite osoraku Konsutantinōpuru o seifuku shitai to omotte imashita.
native: to conquer the south, the Black Sea, the Crimea, maybe even Constantinople.

en: In 1768, the Ottoman Empire declared war on Russia.
zh: 1768年，奧斯曼帝國向俄羅斯宣戰。
ja: 1768年、オスマン帝国はロシアに宣戦布告しました。
local: In 1768, the Ottoman Empire declared war on Russia.
ja_pron: 1768-nen, Osuman Teikoku wa Roshia ni sensen fukoku shimashita.
native: In 1768, the Ottoman Empire declared war on Russia.

en: Catherine forged alliances, practiced diplomacy, and dispatched her troops.
zh: 凱薩琳締結同盟，實行外交，並派遣軍隊。
ja: エカチェリーナは同盟を結び、外交を行い、軍隊を派遣しました。
local: Catherine forged alliances, practiced diplomacy, and dispatched her troops.
ja_pron: Ekacheriina wa dōmei o musubi, gaikō o okonai, guntai o haken shimashita.
native: Catherine forged alliances, practiced diplomacy, and dispatched her troops.

en: Gregory Orloth and later Potemkin took command.
zh: 格雷戈里·奧爾洛夫和後來的波捷姆金指揮作戰。
ja: グレゴリー・オルロフと後のポチョムキンが指揮を執りました。
local: Gregory Orloth and later Potemkin took command.
ja_pron: Guregorī Orurofu to ato no Pochomukin ga shiki o torimashita.
native: Gregory Orloth and later Potemkin took command.

en: For Catherine, it was more than just a military campaign.
zh: 對凱薩琳來說，這不僅僅是一場軍事行動。
ja: エカチェリーナにとって、それは単なる軍事作戦以上のものでした。
local: For Catherine, it was more than just a military campaign.
ja_pron: Ekacheriina ni totte, sore wa tan'na gunji sakusen ijō no mono deshita.
native: For Catherine, it was more than just a military campaign.

en: The plan was bold, occupied the Crimea, pushed back Ottoman influence, and create a new
zh: 計劃大膽，佔領克里米亞，推回奧斯曼的影響，並創造一個新的
ja: 計画は大胆で、クリミアを占領し、オスマンの影響を押し戻し、新しい
local: The plan was bold, occupied the Crimea, pushed back Ottoman influence, and create a new
ja_pron: Keikaku wa daitan de, Kurimia o senryō shi, Osuman no eikyō o oshimodoshi, atarashii
native: The plan was bold, occupied the Crimea, pushed back Ottoman influence, and create a new

en: Russia.
zh: 俄羅斯。
ja: ロシアを作り出すことでした。
local: Russia.
ja_pron: Roshia o tsukuridasu koto deshita.
native: Russia.

en: A flourishing province in the south.
zh: 南方一個繁榮的省份。
ja: 南部の繁栄する州。
local: A flourishing province in the south.
ja_pron: Nanbu no han'ei suru shū.
native: A flourishing province in the south.

en: A shadow fell over the Tsar's empire, not from the west, but from within its own land.
zh: 沙皇帝國籠罩著陰影，陰影不是來自西方，而是來自其自身土地。
ja: ツァーリの帝国に影が落ちました。それは西からではなく、自国の中からでした。
local: A shadow fell over the Tsar's empire, not from the west, but from within its own land.
ja_pron: Tsāri no teikoku ni kage ga ochimashita. Sore wa nishi kara de wa naku, jikoku no naka kara deshita.
native: A shadow fell over the Tsar's empire, not from the west, but from within its own land.

en: In 1773, along the Volga, the people rose up.
zh: 1773年，沿著伏爾加河，人民起義了。
ja: 1773年、ヴォルガ川沿いで人々が蜂起しました。
local: In 1773, along the Volga, the people rose up.
ja_pron: 1773-nen, Voruga-gawa zoi de hitobito ga hōki shimashita.
native: In 1773, along the Volga, the people rose up.

en: Emilian Pugachev, a casa, declared himself to be Tsar Peter III.
zh: 埃米利安·普加喬夫，一名農民，自稱為彼得三世沙皇。
ja: エミリアン・プガチョフという農民が自らをツァーリ・ピョートル3世と宣言しました。
local: Emilian Pugachev, a casa, declared himself to be Tsar Peter III.
ja_pron: Emirian Pugachofu to iu nōmin ga mizukara o Tsāri Pyōtoru Sansei to sengen shimashita.
native: Emilian Pugachev, a casa, declared himself to be Tsar Peter III.

en: The uprising became the greatest revolt in Russian history until the revolution of 1917.
zh: 這場起義成為俄羅斯歷史上最大的反抗，直到1917年的革命。
ja: この蜂起は1917年の革命までロシア史上最大の反乱となりました。
local: The uprising became the greatest revolt in Russian history until the revolution of 1917.
ja_pron: Kono hōki wa 1917-nen no kakumei made Roshia shijō saidai no hanran to narimashita.
native: The uprising became the greatest revolt in Russian history until the revolution of 1917.

en: Surfkossacks, peasants, religious minorities, they all followed the false Tsar.
zh: 哥薩克人、農民、宗教少數群體，他們都跟隨這位假沙皇。
ja: コサック、農民、宗教的少数派が皆偽のツァーリに従いました。
local: Surfkossacks, peasants, religious minorities, they all followed the false Tsar.
ja_pron: Kosakku, nōmin, shūkyōteki shōsūha ga mina nise no Tsāri ni shitagaimashita.
native: Surfkossacks, peasants, religious minorities, they all followed the false Tsar.

en: A war from below against the system, against the nobility, against the Tsars.
zh: 一場來自底層的戰爭，反對體制、貴族和沙皇。
ja: 体制、貴族、ツァーリに対する下からの戦争でした。
local: A war from below against the system, against the nobility, against the Tsars.
ja_pron: Taisei, kizoku, Tsāri ni taisuru shita kara no sensō deshita.
native: A war from below against the system, against the nobility, against the Tsars.

en: Catherine was shaken.
zh: 凱薩琳感到震驚。
ja: エカチェリーナは動揺しました。
local: Catherine was shaken.
ja_pron: Ekacheriina wa dōyō shimashita.
native: Catherine was shaken.

en: The nightmare she had dreaded more than anything else had now truly become a reality.
zh: 她最害怕的噩夢現在真正成為了現實。
ja: 彼女が何よりも恐れていた悪夢が今や本当に現実となりました。
local: The nightmare she had dreaded more than anything else had now truly become a reality.
ja_pron: Kanojo ga nani yori mo osorete ita akumu ga imaya hontō ni genjitsu to narimashita.
native: The nightmare she had dreaded more than anything else had now truly become a reality.

en: She knew it was no longer just about finding the truth, but about the very survival of
zh: 她知道這不再只是尋找真相，而是關乎
ja: 彼女はもはや真実を見つけることだけでなく、
local: She knew it was no longer just about finding the truth, but about the very survival of
ja_pron: Kanojo wa mohaya shinjitsu o mitsukeru koto dake de naku,
native: She knew it was no longer just about finding the truth, but about the very survival of

en: her reign itself.
zh: 她的統治本身的生存。
ja: 彼女の統治そのものの存続に関わることだと知っていました。
local: her reign itself.
ja_pron: Kanojo no tōchi sono mono no sonzoku ni kakawaru koto da to shitte imashita.
native: her reign itself.

en: While Europe was in a state of upheaval, Catherine received a message that changed everything.
zh: 當歐洲處於動盪時，凱薩琳收到了一則改變一切的消息。
ja: ヨーロッパが動乱の状態にある中、エカチェリーナはすべてを変えるメッセージを受け取りました。
local: While Europe was in a state of upheaval, Catherine received a message that changed everything.
ja_pron: Yōroppa ga dōran no jōtai ni aru naka, Ekacheriina wa subete o kaeru messēji o uketorimashita.
native: While Europe was in a state of upheaval, Catherine received a message that changed everything.

en: Gregory Potemkin, who was her closest confidant and her one great love, was on his deathbed.
zh: 格雷戈里·波捷姆金，她最親密的知己和唯一的摯愛，臨終在即。
ja: 彼女の最も親しい信頼者であり、唯一の大きな愛であったグレゴリー・ポチョムキンが臨終にありました。
local: Gregory Potemkin, who was her closest confidant and her one great love, was on his deathbed.
ja_pron: Kanojo no mottomo shitashii shinraisha de ari, yuiitsu no ōkina ai de atta Guregorī Pochomukin ga rinjū ni arimashita.
native: Gregory Potemkin, who was her closest confidant and her one great love, was on his deathbed.

en: I am terribly worried about your health, she wrote.
zh: 她寫道：我非常擔心你的健康。
ja: 彼女は「あなたの健康がとても心配です」と書きました。
local: I am terribly worried about your health, she wrote.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa 'Anata no kenkō ga totemo shinpai desu' to kakimashita.
native: I am terribly worried about your health, she wrote.

en: To belong to the state, you belong to me.
zh: 屬於國家，就屬於我。
ja: 国家に属するなら、あなたは私に属します。
local: To belong to the state, you belong to me.
ja_pron: Kokka ni zokusuru nara, anata wa watashi ni zokusuru.
native: To belong to the state, you belong to me.

en: Potemkin, weakened, answered with final words full of devotion, oh my dear mother, how dreadfully
zh: 波捷姆金虛弱地以充滿奉獻的最後話語回答：親愛的母親，我多麼可怕地
ja: ポチョムキンは弱りながらも、献身に満ちた最後の言葉で答えました。「ああ、親愛なる母よ、なんと恐ろしいことか」
local: Potemkin, weakened, answered with final words full of devotion, oh my dear mother, how dreadfully
ja_pron: Pochomukin wa yowari nagara mo, kenshin ni michita saigo no kotoba de kotaemashita. 'Ā, shin'aina haha yo, nanto osoroshī koto ka'
native: Potemkin, weakened, answered with final words full of devotion, oh my dear mother, how dreadfully

en: sick I am.
zh: 我病得多嚴重。
ja: 私はひどく病んでいます。
local: sick I am.
ja_pron: Watashi wa hidoku yande imasu.
native: sick I am.

en: I beseech the Almighty to watch over your health.
zh: 我懇求全能者保佑你的健康。
ja: 全能の神にあなたの健康を見守るよう懇願します。
local: I beseech the Almighty to watch over your health.
ja_pron: Zennō no kami ni anata no kenkō o mimamoru yō kongan shimasu.
native: I beseech the Almighty to watch over your health.

en: It was more than politics.
zh: 這不僅僅是政治。
ja: それは単なる政治以上のものでした。
local: It was more than politics.
ja_pron: Sore wa tan'na seiji ijō no mono deshita.
native: It was more than politics.

en: That was love's last defiant gasp, a love that survived war, power, separation, and betrayal.
zh: 那是愛情最後的反抗喘息，一種經歷戰爭、權力、分離與背叛仍存活的愛。
ja: それは愛の最後の反抗の息遣いであり、戦争、権力、別離、裏切りを乗り越えた愛でした。
local: That was love's last defiant gasp, a love that survived war, power, separation, and betrayal.
ja_pron: Sore wa ai no saigo no hankō no ikizukai de ari, sensō, kenryoku, betsuri, uragiri o norikoeta ai deshita.
native: That was love's last defiant gasp, a love that survived war, power, separation, and betrayal.

en: In the year 1791, Potemkin passed away while on an inspection tour in Crimea, Catherine's
zh: 1791年，波捷姆金在克里米亞視察時去世，凱薩琳的
ja: 1791年、ポチョムキンはクリミアの視察中に亡くなりました。エカチェリーナの
local: In the year 1791, Potemkin passed away while on an inspection tour in Crimea, Catherine's
ja_pron: 1791-nen, Pochomukin wa Kurimia no shisatsu-chū ni nakunarimashita. Ekacheriina no
native: In the year 1791, Potemkin passed away while on an inspection tour in Crimea, Catherine's

en: final letter still clutched in his hand.
zh: 最後一封信仍緊握在他手中。
ja: 最後の手紙が彼の手にしっかり握られていました。
local: final letter still clutched in his hand.
ja_pron: Saigo no tegami ga kare no te ni shikkari nigirarete imashita.
native: final letter still clutched in his hand.

en: With him, she lost not only a man, but the only person who understood her both as a woman
zh: 隨著他的離去，她失去的不僅是一個男人，而是唯一一個既理解她作為女人
ja: 彼と共に、彼女はただの男性だけでなく、女性としても
local: With him, she lost not only a man, but the only person who understood her both as a woman
ja_pron: Kare to tomo ni, kanojo wa tada no dansei dake de naku, josei to shite mo
native: With him, she lost not only a man, but the only person who understood her both as a woman

en: and a ruler.
zh: 和統治者的唯一理解她的人。
ja: そして支配者としても彼女を理解する唯一の人物を失いました。
local: and a ruler.
ja_pron: Soshite shihaisha to shite mo kanojo o rikai suru yuiitsu no jinbutsu o ushinai mashita.
native: and a ruler.

en: His finest quality was courage, of the heart and of the mind, she wrote.
zh: 她寫道，他最優秀的品質是心靈與思想的勇氣。
ja: 彼の最も優れた資質は心と精神の勇気でした、と彼女は書きました。
local: His finest quality was courage, of the heart and of the mind, she wrote.
ja_pron: Kare no mottomo sugureta shishitsu wa kokoro to seishin no yūki deshita, to kanojo wa kakimashita.
native: His finest quality was courage, of the heart and of the mind, she wrote.

en: It marked the end of a unique partnership, a secret marriage that evolved into a lifelong
zh: 這標誌著一段獨特夥伴關係的結束，一段演變成終身的秘密婚姻
ja: それは独特なパートナーシップの終わりを示し、秘密の結婚が生涯にわたる
local: It marked the end of a unique partnership, a secret marriage that evolved into a lifelong
ja_pron: Sore wa dokutoku na pātonāshippu no owari o shimeshi, himitsu no kekkon ga shōgai ni wataru
native: It marked the end of a unique partnership, a secret marriage that evolved into a lifelong

en: alliance, and a turning point for Catherine.
zh: 聯盟，並成為凱薩琳的轉捩點。
ja: 同盟へと発展し、エカチェリーナにとっての転機となりました。
local: alliance, and a turning point for Catherine.
ja_pron: Dōmei e to hatten shi, Ekacheriina ni totte no tenki to narimashita.
native: alliance, and a turning point for Catherine.

en: From then on, she was alone.
zh: 從那時起，她孤身一人。
ja: それ以来、彼女は一人でした。
local: From then on, she was alone.
ja_pron: Sore irai, kanojo wa hitori deshita.
native: From then on, she was alone.

en: The mental strain attacked her body, Katarina grew tired, sickly, melancholic, and there
zh: 精神壓力侵襲她的身體，凱瑟琳變得疲憊、虛弱、憂鬱，還有
ja: 精神的な負担が彼女の体を蝕み、カタリナは疲れ、病弱で憂鬱になりました、そしてそこには
local: The mental strain attacked her body, Katarina grew tired, sickly, melancholic, and there
ja_pron: Seishinteki na futan ga kanojo no karada o mushibami, Katarina wa tsukare, byōjaku de yūutsu ni narimashita, soshite soko ni wa
native: The mental strain attacked her body, Katarina grew tired, sickly, melancholic, and there

en: was something else.
zh: 還有其他事情。
ja: 他にも何かがありました。
local: was something else.
ja_pron: Hoka ni mo nanika ga arimashita.
native: was something else.

en: Her son, Paul, the heir to the throne whom she never loved, whom she never trusted.
zh: 她的兒子保羅，王位繼承人，她從未愛過，也從未信任過。
ja: 彼女の息子ポール、王位継承者でありながら、彼女は決して愛さず、信頼もしませんでした。
local: Her son, Paul, the heir to the throne whom she never loved, whom she never trusted.
ja_pron: Kanojo no musuko Pōru, ōi keishōsha de ari nagara, kanojo wa kesshite aisazu, shinrai mo shimasen deshita.
native: Her son, Paul, the heir to the throne whom she never loved, whom she never trusted.

en: And he was now set to assume her legacy.
zh: 而他現在將承擔她的遺產。
ja: そして彼は今、彼女の遺産を継ぐことになっていました。
local: And he was now set to assume her legacy.
ja_pron: Soshite kare wa ima, kanojo no isan o tsugu koto ni natte imashita.
native: And he was now set to assume her legacy.

en: She feared that he would destroy everything, that he could lead Russia back into darkness,
zh: 她害怕他會毀掉一切，可能會將俄羅斯帶回黑暗，
ja: 彼女は彼がすべてを破壊し、ロシアを再び暗黒に導くのではないかと恐れていました。
local: She feared that he would destroy everything, that he could lead Russia back into darkness,
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kare ga subete o hakai shi, Roshia o futatabi ankoku ni michibiku no de wa nai ka to osorete imashita.
native: She feared that he would destroy everything, that he could lead Russia back into darkness,

en: and she was no longer able to stop him.
zh: 而她已無法阻止他。
ja: そして彼女はもはや彼を止めることができませんでした。
local: and she was no longer able to stop him.
ja_pron: Soshite kanojo wa mohaya kare o tomeru koto ga dekimasen deshita.
native: and she was no longer able to stop him.

en: November 17, 1796, a day like any other, Katarina gets up early, makes her tea, works.
zh: 1796年11月17日，一個平凡的日子，凱瑟琳早起，泡茶，工作。
ja: 1796年11月17日、いつもと変わらぬ日、カタリナは早起きしてお茶を淹れ、仕事をしました。
local: November 17, 1796, a day like any other, Katarina gets up early, makes her tea, works.
ja_pron: 1796-nen 11-gatsu 17-nichi, itsumo to kawaranu hi, Katarina wa hayaoki shite ocha o irete, shigoto o shimashita.
native: November 17, 1796, a day like any other, Katarina gets up early, makes her tea, works.

en: In the afternoon, a stroke, she collapses on the bathroom, the most powerful woman in Europe.
zh: 下午中風，她倒在浴室裡，歐洲最有權勢的女人。
ja: 午後に脳卒中で倒れ、ヨーロッパで最も権力のある女性が浴室で倒れました。
local: In the afternoon, a stroke, she collapses on the bathroom, the most powerful woman in Europe.
ja_pron: Gogo ni nōsotsuchū de taore, Yōroppa de mottomo kenryoku no aru josei ga yokushitsu de taoremashita.
native: In the afternoon, a stroke, she collapses on the bathroom, the most powerful woman in Europe.

en: No one had anticipated such a sudden and abrupt ending.
zh: 沒有人預料到如此突然且急促的結局。
ja: 誰もこんな突然で急な終わりを予想していませんでした。
local: No one had anticipated such a sudden and abrupt ending.
ja_pron: Dare mo konna totsuzen de kyū na owari o yosō shite imasen deshita.
native: No one had anticipated such a sudden and abrupt ending.

en: Paul there became Tsar, a man whom Catherine neither valued nor loved.
zh: 保羅成為了沙皇，一個凱薩琳既不重視也不愛的人。
ja: ポールはツァーリとなり、エカチェリーナが評価も愛情も持たなかった男でした。
local: Paul there became Tsar, a man whom Catherine neither valued nor loved.
ja_pron: Pōru wa Tsāri to nari, Ekacheriina ga hyōka mo aijō mo motanakatta otoko deshita.
native: Paul there became Tsar, a man whom Catherine neither valued nor loved.

en: What remains of her is encapsulated in her own epitaph.
zh: 她留下的都濃縮在她自己的墓誌銘中。
ja: 彼女の遺したものは彼女自身の墓碑銘に凝縮されています。
local: What remains of her is encapsulated in her own epitaph.
ja_pron: Kanojo no nokoshita mono wa kanojo jishin no bohimei ni gyōshuku sarete imasu.
native: What remains of her is encapsulated in her own epitaph.

en: She wanted to please her husband, the Tsars and the people.
zh: 她想取悅她的丈夫、沙皇和人民。
ja: 彼女は夫、ツァーリ、そして民衆を喜ばせたかったのです。
local: She wanted to please her husband, the Tsars and the people.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa otto, Tsāri, soshite minshū o yorokobasetakatta no desu.
native: She wanted to please her husband, the Tsars and the people.

en: She read many books.
zh: 她讀了許多書。
ja: 彼女は多くの本を読みました。
local: She read many books.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa ōku no hon o yomimashita.
native: She read many books.

en: She hated no one, had a truly good heart and had friends.
zh: 她不恨任何人，擁有一顆真正善良的心，也有朋友。
ja: 彼女は誰も憎まず、本当に優しい心を持ち、友人もいました。
local: She hated no one, had a truly good heart and had friends.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa dare mo nikumazu, hontō ni yasashii kokoro o mochi, yūjin mo imashita.
native: She hated no one, had a truly good heart and had friends.

en: But what became of her children, Katarina gave birth to four children.
zh: 但她的孩子們怎麼樣了，凱瑟琳生了四個孩子。
ja: しかし彼女の子供たちはどうなったのか、カタリナは4人の子供を産みました。
local: But what became of her children, Katarina gave birth to four children.
ja_pron: Shikashi kanojo no kodomotachi wa dō natta no ka, Katarina wa yonin no kodomo o umimashita.
native: But what became of her children, Katarina gave birth to four children.

en: It is likely that none were fathered by her husband, Peter III.
zh: 很可能沒有一個是她的丈夫彼得三世的親生子。
ja: おそらく誰も夫のピョートル3世の子ではなかったでしょう。
local: It is likely that none were fathered by her husband, Peter III.
ja_pron: Osoraku dare mo otto no Pyōtoru Sansei no ko de wa nakatta deshō.
native: It is likely that none were fathered by her husband, Peter III.

en: And yet he recognized the first born, Paul as the heir to the throne.
zh: 然而，他承認了長子保羅為王位繼承人。
ja: それでも彼は長男ポールを王位継承者として認めました。
local: And yet he recognized the first born, Paul as the heir to the throne.
ja_pron: Soredemo kare wa chōnan Pōru o ōi keishōsha to shite mitomemashita.
native: And yet he recognized the first born, Paul as the heir to the throne.

en: All the first, born in 1754, a difficult child and unloved son, but ultimately he was
zh: 所有的長子，生於1754年，是個難管教且不受寵愛的兒子，但最終他是
ja: 1754年生まれの長男は、手のかかる子で愛されない息子でしたが、最終的には彼が
local: All the first, born in 1754, a difficult child and unloved son, but ultimately he was
ja_pron: 1754-nen umare no chōnan wa, te no kakaru ko de aisarenai musuko deshita ga, saishūteki ni wa kare ga
native: All the first, born in 1754, a difficult child and unloved son, but ultimately he was

en: the only legitimate heir to the throne.
zh: 唯一合法的王位繼承人。
ja: 唯一の正当な王位継承者でした。
local: the only legitimate heir to the throne.
ja_pron: Yuiitsu no seitōna ōi keishōsha deshita.
native: the only legitimate heir to the throne.

en: After Catherine's death, he ascended the throne, but his reign was short and ended tragically.
zh: 凱薩琳去世後，他繼承了王位，但他的統治短暫且悲劇收場。
ja: エカチェリーナの死後、彼は王位に就きましたが、その治世は短く悲劇的に終わりました。
local: After Catherine's death, he ascended the throne, but his reign was short and ended tragically.
ja_pron: Ekacheriina no shigo, kare wa ōi ni tsukimashita ga, sono chisei wa mijikaku higekiteki ni owarimashita.
native: After Catherine's death, he ascended the throne, but his reign was short and ended tragically.

en: He introduced unpopular reforms, stripped nobles of their power, and was ultimately assassinated
zh: 他推行了不受歡迎的改革，剝奪了貴族的權力，最終被暗殺
ja: 彼は不人気な改革を導入し、貴族から権力を奪い、最終的に暗殺されました
local: He introduced unpopular reforms, stripped nobles of their power, and was ultimately assassinated
ja_pron: Kare wa fuhitsuyō na kaikaku o dōnyū shi, kizoku kara kenryoku o ubai, saishūteki ni ansatsu saremashita
native: He introduced unpopular reforms, stripped nobles of their power, and was ultimately assassinated

ja_pron: Sen happyaku roku nen ni

en: Officers mounted a midnight coup.
zh: 軍官們發動了午夜政變。
ja: 将校たちが真夜中にクーデターを起こしました。
local: Officers mounted a midnight coup.
ja_pron: Shōkō-tachi ga mayonaka ni kūdetā o okoshimashita
native: Officers mounted a midnight coup.

en: Paul's death was officially listed as occurring in his sleep.
zh: 保羅的死被官方記錄為睡夢中去世。
ja: パウルの死は公式には眠っている間に起きたと記録されました。
local: Paul's death was officially listed as occurring in his sleep.
ja_pron: Pauru no shi wa kōshiki ni wa nemutte iru aida ni okita to kiroku saremashita
native: Paul's death was officially listed as occurring in his sleep.

en: The truth didn't emerge for another 50 years.
zh: 真相直到50年後才浮出水面。
ja: 真実はさらに50年後まで明らかになりませんでした。
local: The truth didn't emerge for another 50 years.
ja_pron: Shinjitsu wa sara ni gojū-nen go made akiraka ni narimasen deshita
native: The truth didn't emerge for another 50 years.

en: Anna Petrovna, born in 1757, died when she was barely two years old, a short life.
zh: 安娜·彼得羅芙娜，1757年出生，僅活到兩歲，生命短暫。
ja: アンナ・ペトロヴナは1757年に生まれ、わずか2歳で亡くなりました。短い生涯でした。
local: Anna Petrovna, born in 1757, died when she was barely two years old, a short life.
ja_pron: Anna Petorovuna wa sen nana hyaku gojū nana nen ni umare, wazuka ni-sai de nakunarimashita. Mijikai shōgai deshita
native: Anna Petrovna, born in 1757, died when she was barely two years old, a short life.

en: There are hardly any traces in the archives, a quiet chapter.
zh: 檔案中幾乎沒有任何痕跡，是一段寧靜的篇章。
ja: 記録にはほとんど痕跡がなく、静かな章です。
local: There are hardly any traces in the archives, a quiet chapter.
ja_pron: Kiroku ni wa hotondo konseki ga naku, shizuka na shō desu
native: There are hardly any traces in the archives, a quiet chapter.

en: Alexei, born in 1762, probably from the affair with Gregory Orlov.
zh: 阿列克謝，1762年出生，可能是與格雷戈里·奧爾洛夫的私情所生。
ja: アレクセイは1762年に生まれ、おそらくグレゴリー・オルロフとの不倫の子です。
local: Alexei, born in 1762, probably from the affair with Gregory Orlov.
ja_pron: Arekusei wa sen nana hyaku rokujū ni nen ni umare, osoraku Guregorī Orurofu to no furin no ko desu
native: Alexei, born in 1762, probably from the affair with Gregory Orlov.

en: He grew up in the shadows, far from the public eye, without a title, without a claim.
zh: 他在陰影中長大，遠離公眾視線，沒有頭銜，沒有權利主張。
ja: 彼は影の中で育ち、公の目から遠く、称号も権利も持ちませんでした。
local: He grew up in the shadows, far from the public eye, without a title, without a claim.
ja_pron: Kare wa kage no naka de sodachi, ōyake no me kara tōku, shōgō mo kenri mo mochimasen deshita
native: He grew up in the shadows, far from the public eye, without a title, without a claim.

en: A child who has never allowed to exist politically.
zh: 一個從未被允許在政治上存在的孩子。
ja: 政治的に存在を許されなかった子供です。
local: A child who has never allowed to exist politically.
ja_pron: Seijiteki ni sonzai o yurusarenakatta kodomo desu
native: A child who has never allowed to exist politically.

en: Elizabetha, born in 1775, the secret daughter of Catherine and Potemkin.
zh: 伊莉莎白，1775年出生，是凱瑟琳和波特金的秘密女兒。
ja: エリザベータは1775年に生まれ、エカテリーナとポチョムキンの秘密の娘です。
local: Elizabetha, born in 1775, the secret daughter of Catherine and Potemkin.
ja_pron: Erizabēta wa sen nana hyaku nanajū go nen ni umare, Ekaterīna to Pochomukin no himitsu no musume desu
native: Elizabetha, born in 1775, the secret daughter of Catherine and Potemkin.

en: She too was kept hidden.
zh: 她也被隱藏起來。
ja: 彼女もまた隠されていました。
local: She too was kept hidden.
ja_pron: Kanojo mo mata kakusarete imashita
native: She too was kept hidden.

en: Her true parentage remained a secret known to very few.
zh: 她的真實身世仍是少數人知道的秘密。
ja: 彼女の本当の親子関係はごく少数の人しか知らない秘密のままでした。
local: Her true parentage remained a secret known to very few.
ja_pron: Kanojo no hontō no oyako kankei wa goku shōsū no hito shika shiranai himitsu no mama deshita
native: Her true parentage remained a secret known to very few.

en: Katarina had her raised in safety, far from the court, and away from the intrigues of power.
zh: 凱瑟琳讓她在安全的環境中長大，遠離宮廷和權力的陰謀。
ja: カタリナは彼女を宮廷から遠く離れた安全な場所で育て、権力の陰謀から守りました。
local: Katarina had her raised in safety, far from the court, and away from the intrigues of power.
ja_pron: Katarina wa kanojo o kyūtei kara tōku hanareta anzen na basho de sodate, kenryoku no inbō kara mamorimashita
native: Katarina had her raised in safety, far from the court, and away from the intrigues of power.

en: Russia became stronger under Catherine's reign than ever before, a great power, an empire.
zh: 俄羅斯在凱瑟琳統治下比以往任何時候都更強大，成為一個強國，一個帝國。
ja: ロシアはエカテリーナの治世の下でかつてないほど強くなり、大国、帝国となりました。
local: Russia became stronger under Catherine's reign than ever before, a great power, an empire.
ja_pron: Roshia wa Ekaterīna no chisei no moto de katsute nai hodo tsuyoku nari, taikoku, teikoku to narimashita
native: Russia became stronger under Catherine's reign than ever before, a great power, an empire.

en: Catherine II, the last great ruler of Europe, between light and shadow.
zh: 凱瑟琳二世，歐洲最後一位偉大的統治者，介於光明與陰影之間。
ja: エカテリーナ2世、ヨーロッパ最後の偉大な支配者、光と影の間に。
local: Catherine II, the last great ruler of Europe, between light and shadow.
ja_pron: Ekaterīna nisei, Yōroppa saigo no idaina shihaisha, hikari to kage no aida ni
native: Catherine II, the last great ruler of Europe, between light and shadow.

en: And to this day remains one of the most fascinating women in world history.
zh: 直到今天，她仍然是世界歷史上最迷人的女性之一。
ja: そして今日に至るまで、彼女は世界史上最も魅力的な女性の一人であり続けています。
local: And to this day remains one of the most fascinating women in world history.
ja_pron: Soshite kyō ni itaru made, kanojo wa sekaishi jō mottomo miryokuteki na josei no hitori de ari tsuzukete imasu
native: And to this day remains one of the most fascinating women in world history.
